typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberNum as string,
		Phone as string,
		Condition as string,
		MemberSource as string,
		CustomUse as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(FileIID = $File_IID) ~> AddFileId
AddFileId derive(Phone_NonUnicode = toString(Phone),
		MemberNum_NonUnicode = toString(MemberNum),
		CustomUse_NonUnicode = toString(CustomUse),
		Condition_NonUnicode = toString(Condition),
		MemberSource_NonUnicode = toString(MemberSource)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CUSTOMUSE as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CONDITION as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBER_SOURCE as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID as long,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CUSTOMUSE = CustomUse_NonUnicode,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_CONDITION = Condition_NonUnicode,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBER_SOURCE = MemberSource_NonUnicode,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNum_NonUnicode,
		DMCCULIST_STAGING_MEMBERPHONE = Phone_NonUnicode)) ~> OLEDBDestination
